headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2026: the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Kyle Fletcher vs. Mark Briscoe went to war in a Ladder match, appearing on Grand Slam: Australia, rated 8.29 ? a fantastic contest. Fletcher and Briscoe renewed their rivalry down under, the TNT Champion defending against the man who's given him more trouble than almost anyone else in AEW.
It was 2024 when Orange Cassidy vs. Matt Taven fought it out in a Texas Death Match, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 7.78 ? a strong outing in a hard-fought men's division clash.
On this day in 2024, after 117 matches, Matt Jackson debuted a bold new identity: Matthew Jackson, on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2026, when MJF vs. Brody King put the AEW World Heavyweight Title on the line, appearing on Grand Slam: Australia, rated 7.07 ? a good, competitive contest.
On a Saturday in 2026, back when Jon Moxley vs. Konosuke Takeshita fought tooth and nail for the AEW Continental Title, appearing on Grand Slam: Australia, rated 7.73 ? a solid showing.

On a Saturday in 2026, back when Babes Of Wrath vs. MegaBad fought tooth and nail for the AEW Women's World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Grand Slam: Australia, rated 5.56. It was the first title opportunity of MegaBad's career.
